shape.text: A user token is the prefix squ_ followed by exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters, 44 characters in all, with no checksum. SonarQube's token generator builds it as sq, a type letter, an underscore, and 20 random bytes hex-encoded; the type letter u marks a user token.

issuance.text: A token is typically supplied through the SONAR_TOKEN environment variable, the sonar.token scanner property (or the older sonar.login), a sonar.token entry in a project properties file, or a Gradle system property.
How a token is created in the product, and what it looks like in the interface, is not recorded.

unresolved.reason: No token was issued; the grammar comes from the server's token generator, which needs no issued key to read.

collisions.text: A 40-hex body alone has the shape of a SHA-1 digest such as a git commit id, so the squ_ prefix is what identifies the token. Project badge tokens (sqb_) are read-only and published in README badge URLs by design.

openQuestions.text: Tokens issued before SonarQube 9.5 are unprefixed 40-hex values, and SonarQube Cloud issues a differently prefixed token (sqco_); how they relate to the user token is not recorded.

unresolved.reason: Recorded in a research note without a cited source for the unprefixed form and for the SonarQube Cloud sqco_ form.
